title: Execution of the Punishment of Whipping Amendment Ordinance 1984

sections.shortTitle: Execution of the Punishment of Whipping Amendment Ordinance 1984
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE I OF 1984
ORDINANCE I OF 1984
EXECUTION OF THE PUNISHMENT OF WHIPPING (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance to amend the
Execution of the Punishment of Whipping Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 8th January, 1984]
No. F. 17(1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hearby published for general
information :-- -
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Execution of the Punishment of Whipping (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
